edition.check: Level 5: INPUT contains a barcode -> NOT MET (input has no barcode). Level 4: Without barcode, title, artist, format and at least one further attribute unambiguous in >= 2 sources, and no other edition fitting the input has a different tracklist -> NOT MET (the input specifies only title, artist, and format 'Kassette', which fits six distinct cassette editions/pressings from 2001 to 2003 on Discogs master 211928 with differing years and cover/sticker details, so no single pressing is unambiguous from the input alone). Level 3: Several editions fit but ALL share the same tracklist (e.g. repressings, country editions): the choice does not matter -> MET (all six cassette pressings discogs:release/1951581, 18354001, 18354166, 18354289, 17280904, 4256710 as well as musicbrainz:release/19fd3695-68df-4e95-884a-da6938aae5cf and musik-sammler.de release 917995 share the exact same 16 tracks and 2979 s total duration).
edition.summary: Six German cassette pressings from 2001–2003 fit the barcode-less input, so the specific pressing is not unambiguous, but all six share the exact same 16-track tracklist.

tracklist.check: Level 5: >= 2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles (spelling variants only) -> MET (musicbrainz:release/19fd3695-68df-4e95-884a-da6938aae5cf, discogs:release/1951581, and web:https://www.musik-sammler.de/release/bushido-king-of-kingz-tape-917995/ all represent the 2001 cassette edition and agree on all 16 tracks in the same A1–A8 / B1–B8 order and exact track durations, with only minor spelling/punctuation variants such as 'Nute Bounce' vs 'Nutte Bounce', 'Pitbull' vs 'Pit Bull', 'Hast du Mut' vs 'Hast Du Mut?', and 'Vack You!' vs 'Vack You').
tracklist.summary: Two independent databases and musik-sammler.de agree on all 16 tracks, their order, and exact durations, differing only in minor spelling variants.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: Database + independent primary source (read cover/booklet/label print, label or manufacturer information) of the same edition -> NOT MET (tl-vision in tool calls 8–10 read 0 tracks from the outer J-card and cassette stickers, which are also hosted on discogs:release/1951581 rather than an independent primary tracklist source). Level 4: Two independent database entries (recognisable by differing details) or database + specialised collector site (e.g. musik-sammler.de) -> MET (MusicBrainz and Discogs are clearly independent entries with differing catalogue numbers 'ILM 003' vs '03', different title spellings, and featured-artist credits present only in MusicBrainz, supplemented by the specialised collector site musik-sammler.de with its own numbering 'B 9.'–'B 16.' and alias credit '[Feat. Baktus & Orgasmus]').
sources.summary: The result is backed by two independent database entries (MusicBrainz and Discogs) plus the specialised collector site musik-sammler.de, while cover images yielded no readable tracklist.
